checks.name: contract gate
checks.limitation: Structural validation only; contract semantics were reviewed against problem.txt.

checks.name: static RTL review
checks.details: Exact TopModule ports and unsigned 8-bit widths; fully driven continuous combinational assignments; no clock, reset, state, latches, dependencies, or simulation-only RTL.

checks.name: development simulation
checks.coverage: All-equal range, unique-minimum positions, ties, extrema, unsigned 127/128 boundary, exhaustive a/b pairs with c=d=255, and 10000 deterministic pseudorandom vectors.

development_outcome: Initial candidate passed all development checks without RTL revisions. candidate_initial.sv was preserved immediately after implementation and before development checks. Pure combinational unsigned minimum selection uses two pairwise minima followed by a final comparison.
limitations: Development simulation is not exhaustive over all four-input combinations.
X/Z behavior is unspecified by the original problem and was not tested.
No synthesis, implementation timing, or board checks performed.
Official evaluation is external and its results are unavailable.
